title: Hy4 Flash open weights and community GGUF quantizations published
summary: Open weights for Hy4 Flash were released alongside community GGUF quantizations, enabling local multi-GPU execution with VRAM requirements starting at 126 GB for IQ2 quantization.
research_notes:
Clone the official repository or install supported inference runtimes such as vLLM and Transformers.

Download model weights from Hugging Face for the desired variant, such as tencent/Hy4-flash for general instruction following or tencent/Hy4-flash-FP8 for memory-efficient deployment.

For consumer multi-GPU or high-memory local systems, download quantized GGUF weights from AngelSlim/Hy4-flash-GGUF and run via compatible llama.cpp or text-generation loaders.

Deploy the FP8 quantized checkpoint or enable speculative decoding with the DFly draft head to maximize throughput above 150 tokens per second while managing VRAM consumption.

Ensure adequate GPU memory allocations when loading the 1M context window, noting that KV cache size is optimized to 1/6 of Hy4 via hybrid attention.

For local workstations, allocate at least 126 GB of aggregate VRAM across GPUs when using the IQ2 quantization format to prevent out-of-memory errors during offload.
